fix: :reload-all, sync all views of a reloaded document `:reload-all` reloads each document by re-reading it from disk and committing the diff to history through `view_ids[0]` only. With a split showing the same document in more than one window, the other views are left pointing at the pre-reload revision: their `doc_revisions` and jumplist entries still describe the old (e.g. larger) buffer.
